note: How a TRELLIS.2 reconstruction of a ranged weapon is fitted to the weapon part contract (scripts/ranged-fit.py): which reconstruction axes become the part's axes, the size, where the grip sits, the phone budget and the part's userData. `cFromG` is the 3x3 matrix taking the reconstruction's glTF axes (x right, y up, z toward the viewer in the concept picture) to the part's (x, y along the weapon, z the string side / top of the stock). `autoFlipZ` turns the part 180 degrees about Y when its tips sit on the -Z side of the grip (the string side must be +Z); `brighten` multiplies the colour map (TRELLIS read the bow wood nearly black).
